source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    seeds = [(r, c) for r, c in points if r0 < r < r1 and c0 < c < c1]
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            out[r][c] = 4
            if any(max(abs(r - sr), abs(c - sc)) > 0 and max(abs(r - sr), abs(c - sc)) % 2 == 0 for sr, sc in seeds):
                out[r][c] = 2
    for r, c in seeds:
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
